research_scope: Shadow Crusher acquisition and Ultimate Finish field audit.

ultimate_finish_required.reason: Mentor training is the documented acquisition route, so PQ Ultimate Finish logic is inapplicable. The repository keeps this field null rather than conflating non-PQ acquisition with a boolean PQ condition.

usable_by_cac.reason: Future Warrior mentor-training acquisition is documented.

findings.current_evidence_note: Current community references continue to identify Shadow Crusher as a Ki Blast counter, while the canonical skill identity remains Super / Strike.

audit_conclusion: No correction required. Existing conservative null handling for ultimate_finish_required is appropriate.
